description.value: The Shepherd's Inn is a family-owned roadside complex positioned at Mile 72 of the Alaska Highway, 42 km northwest of Fort St John — a remote stretch where services are scarce. The property combines a motel, sit-down restaurant, convenience store, and gas/diesel fueling station, billing itself as 'an oasis on the Alaska Highway.' For touring cyclists riding the Alaska Highway corridor, it is one of the few full-service stops between Fort St John and Fort Nelson.

address.value: 11890 Shepherds Inn Frontage Road, Charlie Lake, V1J 8L5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is real, open year-round, and operating as a motel/restaurant/convenience store/gas station complex on the Alaska Highway at Mile 72. Phone (+1-250-827-3676), address (11890 Shepherds Inn Frontage Rd, Charlie Lake BC V1J 8L5), and website URL all match between OSM tags and the contact page. No bike-specific amenities (parking, rack, pump) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null; hot food and basic groceries are confirmed by explicit website text.
concerns: OSM record names only the convenience store component ('The Shepherd's Inn - Convenience Store'), but the property is a larger complex (motel, restaurant, store, gas station). The store is a legitimate subset of the business and the OSM entry is not wrong, but future records for other components (e.g., the motel or restaurant) could appear as apparent duplicates.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, year-round business confirmed by website; a significant service stop on a remote segment of the Alaska Highway cycling route.
enrichment_extras.notes: Gas and diesel vehicle fuel available on site per website ('Gas and diesel sales'). RV and bus tours specifically welcomed, suggesting ample parking space.

Hot food.detail: Full restaurant on site: 'Home cooked meals, breakfast all day, homemade breads, baked goods and soups made from scratch.' To-go orders also available
